name: io.github.chrischall/vibo-mcp
description: Vibo (vibodj.com) MCP — plan & manage event music: timeline, songs, ideas, questions, guests

environmentVariables.name: VIBO_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Vibo account email (or use VIBO_ACCESS_TOKEN for SSO accounts)

environmentVariables.name: VIBO_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Captured x-token from a signed-in web.vibodj.com session (SSO alternative)

environmentVariables.name: VIBO_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Matching x-refresh-token so the session can renew

environmentVariables.name: VIBO_UPLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The upload directory: vibo_set_profile_photo and photo/file answers to vibo_answer_question only read local files from it. Default ~/Downloads/vibo-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: VIBO_SESSION_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Where a browser-captured token pair is persisted so it survives MCP restarts. Default ~/.vibo-mcp/session.json.

environmentVariables.name: VIBO_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the Vibo GraphQL endpoint. Default https://api.vibodj.com/v2/graphql.
